recognize_zh: 大型芽細胞具豐富、偏灰藍色的胞質，部分胞質含細小嗜天青顆粒並可見核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），核染色質細緻、部分核有凹陷，旁邊有成熟的小淋巴球作為大小對照，符合 t(8;21) AML 的芽細胞形態。
features: Large blasts, roughly 3 times the size of an adjacent small lymphocyte
Moderate to abundant basophilic to grayish-blue cytoplasm, some with fine azurophilic granules
Round to indented nuclei with fine chromatin and faint nucleoli
Suggestion of a paranuclear clear zone (hof) in some cells
No definite Auer rods visible at this resolution
describe_en: Smear at high power shows a cluster of large myeloblasts with moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm, several containing fine azurophilic granules, and round to indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and faint nucleoli. Some blasts show a paranuclear pale zone. A small mature lymphocyte is present for size comparison. Auer rods are not definitely identified in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia and are suggestive of AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1, which should be confirmed by cytogenetics or molecular testing.

ddx.vs: APL cells have bilobed or folded nuclei with heavy granules or bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells) and PML::RARA, rather than basophilic cytoplasm with hofs.
AML with inv(16) shows a myelomonocytic picture with abnormal eosinophils containing large basophilic granules.
Lymphoblasts have scant agranular cytoplasm and are MPO-negative, whereas these blasts have abundant granular cytoplasm.
